steps.description: Connect the Xero account that holds your client organisations (one connection covers every organisation it can see). A mailbox is optional: the intake mailbox lets the agent file emailed bills, statements and invoice requests; the sending mailbox lets it send reviewed emails to clients. People are named at activation and clients are onboarded afterwards.
steps.title: Connections

description: Connections only: connect Xero, and optionally the intake mailbox and a sending mailbox. The manager and reviewer are named when the agent is activated; each client is onboarded afterwards through the agent (its Client onboarding process), and thresholds are the agent's own preferences.
name: Xero Bookkeeper setup
